assets.title: A superagent. With a QBasic soul.
assets.prompt:
Use case: text-localization.
Asset type: first image of a five-image English commercial campaign for S42 Agent, square 1:1.
Input image 1 is the EDIT TARGET: the existing Spanish S42 Agent campaign poster numbered 01 / 05.
Create a polished English edition of this poster. Preserve the overall composition, square canvas, premium retro-computing identity, near-black navy dotted background, DOS-blue terminal, cyan/off-white typography, thin borders, classic rectangular gray windows with [X], pixel mouse pointer, headline hierarchy, safe margins, brand wordmark, footer and feature icons. Keep the layout recognizably a QBasic TEXT-BASED terminal. Adjust only text sizing/line breaks within the existing areas to fit the English copy cleanly. No additional objects.
Replace ALL Spanish text with these exact English equivalents:
Headline in two lines:
"A superagent."
"With a QBasic soul."
Emphasize "QBasic" in cyan.
Subtitle: "AI power. A terminal you'll love."
Terminal menu: "File  Projects  Models  Promptings  Tools  View" with "Help" at far right.
Project tab: "P:my-project"; file tab: "F:index.ts"; central title: "my-project".
Chat:
"You: Build a landing page for my project."
"Agent: I'll review the files and build it."
"list → src/"
"write → index.html"
Keep You yellow, Agent cyan, and the body neutral.
Window 1 title: "Native tools" with [X], content "read · write · edit · shell".
Window 2 title: "Projects" with [X], content "Name: my-project" and "Folder: ./my-project".
The fixed bottom panel remains titled "Prompt". Keyboard hint: "Enter: send · Shift+Enter: new line".
Three feature captions: "WINDOWS + MOUSE", "VIM SHORTCUTS", "100% BUN".
Footer unchanged: "Open source · MIT" and "github.com/stock42/s42-agent".
Constraints: all copy and UI examples in English, exact spelling, no Spanish leftovers, no Send button, no rounded web dashboard elements, no fabricated metrics or new capability claims. Deliver ONE finished commercial PNG image.

assets.title: Fast. Backed by numbers.
assets.prompt:
Use case: text-localization, precise benchmark infographic.
Asset type: fifth image of the English S42 Agent commercial campaign, square 1:1, exclusively the recorded benchmark.
Input image 1 is the EDIT TARGET, existing Spanish benchmark poster 05 / 05.
Create its polished English edition. Preserve the full composition: S42 AGENT wordmark, 05 / 05, navy dotted background, bold off-white/cyan headline, one large DOS-blue startup metric panel, four blue metric panels in a two-by-two grid, fine cyan corner borders, method area and footer. Adjust text sizes and wrapping for excellent readability. Do not add charts, other numbers, performance promises or product features.
English headline:
"Fast."
"Backed by numbers."
Emphasize "numbers" in cyan.
Subtitle: "Recorded benchmark · v0.1.0 · Linux x64".
Keep exactly the same measured values, converting decimal commas to English decimal periods:
Main panel: "24.43 ms" / "Startup · p95".
Four panels in reading order:
"35.95 ms" / "Input · p95".
"4.07 ms" / "SSE delta to frame · p95".
"46.64 MiB" / "Idle RSS memory".
"42.07 ms" / "Resume 1,000 messages".
MiB must be uppercase M, lowercase dotted i, uppercase B, NOT MIB. Prefer a clearly mixed-case typeface for units. Resume is a single measured duration, not p95. Only the first three timing metrics use p95. Do not confuse RSS memory with latency.
Method lines below panels, exactly:
"30 startups · 100 inputs · 20 SSE deltas"
"PTY · warm cache · excludes LLM inference"
"Received bytes measured; emulator painting excluded."
"Core Ultra 9 275HX · Ubuntu 24.04.5 · Bun 1.4.2"
Footer: "Source: docs/qa/final-validation.md" and "github.com/stock42/s42-agent".
Constraints: all labels in English; accurate English punctuation and decimal points. This is a HISTORICAL recorded v0.1.0 Linux x64 harness benchmark, not a new measurement, not an LLM benchmark. No tokens/sec, comparisons, awards, OS compatibility badges, percentage claims or invented values. Method lines legible, not tiny microtext. ONE finished benchmark image.
edits:
Use case: precise-object-edit, numeric typography correction.
Input image 1 is the EDIT TARGET, English S42 Agent benchmark poster 05 / 05.
Make one targeted correction: localize the FIVE metric numeric strings into English typography. The previous image incorrectly retained Spanish decimal commas.
Replace the five large metric values EXACTLY as follows:
Top startup panel: "24.43 ms".
Middle-left input panel: "35.95 ms".
Middle-right SSE panel: "4.07 ms".
Bottom-left memory panel: "46.64 MiB".
Bottom-right resume panel: "42.07 ms".
Every decimal separator between these digits MUST be a visible small PERIOD "." (dot on the baseline, NO comma tail). This is mandatory.
Memory unit is exactly MiB: uppercase M, lowercase dotted i, uppercase B. Use visibly mixed-case unit typography, never all capitals MIB.
KEEP the comma in "Resume 1,000 messages" because that is a thousands separator.
Preserve absolutely everything else: all measured digits, all English words and labels, headline, wordmark, brand colors, background, five panels, method lines, footer, spacing, dimensions and composition. No added elements or other text changes. The only changes are the five metric value formats just specified.
